name: DashCore
description: DashCore 0.8.7-alpha: Android64 diagnostic build for Geometry Dash. Separates callback execution cost from callback cadence, reports p50/p95/p99 intervals and counts gaps over 50ms and 100ms. No rendering optimization is enabled; live culling remains hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Diagnostic alpha only. Live object hiding is hard-disabled until trigger classification and camera-space bounds are validated.
